question: can a mechanism compress content that is not redundant at all, while keeping both the strict track and the semantic answer quality at or above the baseline?
why_this_is_the_remaining_question: the v20 round established that the existing mechanism is an evidence preserving redundancy remover: it removes only redundant content and its literal guard refuses to remove any output that uniquely carries a registered required literal. On a shape where each view is read once it therefore measures 0.00 percent. Compressing unique content requires a mechanism that removes non evidence material while keeping every literal, which is a design question, not a measurement of the old rule

design.shape: N3 from the v19 dose: three development tasks, one distinct view per round, three rounds, each view read exactly once, so there are no duplicates at all; on this shape the current configuration measures 0.00 percent, which makes any positive number attributable to the new mechanism and to nothing else
design.tasks: the three v16 development tasks, unchanged views, ranges, hashes, contracts and literals
design.samples: 3 tasks x 1 repeat x 3 arms = 9, with a second stage of 27 samples only on explicit approval
design.everything_else_fixed: renderer, contract, four strict track conditions, 160 character bound, one billed retry, arm charged summaries, read-only tools

mechanism_under_test.name: literal carrier preserving line elision
mechanism_under_test.where: the plugin arm only, on top of the existing duplicate rule, after it
rule: for each tool output that is not part of the most recent tool group, keep verbatim every line that contains a registered literal or registered constraint phrase, case insensitive exact substring, together with a fixed window of three lines before and three lines after each such line, clipped to the output
elide every other line and replace each maximal contiguous omitted run with exactly one note line of the form [elided n lines first-last] and nothing else
the newest tool group is kept verbatim, the same recency policy the existing lineage uses
mechanism_under_test.the_window_is_frozen_now: three lines before and after; it is declared here and may not be changed after any saving number is seen
mechanism_under_test.fail_closed: if the literal preservation invariant fails for any output, that output is kept verbatim and a fallback is counted; the mechanism never removes content it cannot prove is literal safe

the_invariant_that_makes_this_legitimate: for every registered literal and constraint phrase, the number of verbatim occurrences in the payload after elision must be greater than or equal to the number before it, per occurrence and not per distinct string; the counts are computed the same way v5._carrier_loss computes them, so the new mechanism is held to the bar that already vetoed the old one

the_honesty_guard_this_experiment_needs.risk: the strict track is literal based, so a mechanism that kept only literal carrying lines could pass the strict track while destroying the reasoning material the model needs; that would be a saving bought with quality
the_honesty_guard_this_experiment_needs.therefore: the semantic answer correctness the pipeline already reports is a co primary endpoint here, not a secondary one
the_honesty_guard_this_experiment_needs.rule: if semantic correctness falls below the baseline on any task, the result is recorded as quality traded for tokens, the mechanism is not tuned, and the attempt is reported as a failure

decision_line.capability_confirmed: paired saving on the no duplicate shape at least 5 percent with three of three pairs positive AND every arm's strict track at or above the baseline AND semantic answer correctness at or above the baseline on every task AND zero render failures and zero truncations in the plugin arm
decision_line.quality_traded_for_tokens: any task where the strict track or the semantic correctness falls below the baseline, or any render failure or truncation; stop and report, do not tune the window
decision_line.capability_absent: saving indistinguishable from zero, or the engagement counters zero, meaning the mechanism does not engage or removes nothing; stop and report
decision_line.inconclusive: positive but below 5 percent, or mixed signs; report and ask

pre_flight_requirements_zero_api: the four v20 assertions must hold again: finalisation really exercised inside the gate with every pre registered key present, the trigger gate firing on every model input after the first, per module sha256 pinning with revision aware fail closed, and the mechanism engagement counters non zero on the no duplicate shape

a dedicated invariant test: given an output where a registered literal occurs exactly once, the mechanism must either keep the line carrying it or revert that output entirely; a synthetic case proves both paths
a dedicated test that the note line never becomes a carrier of a literal and that omitted interval notes are well formed
a dedicated test that the newest tool group is never modified

budget.stage_one: 9 samples, expected about 0.006 dollars off peak, to be authorised by the integrator after the gates are green
budget.stage_two: 27 samples, expected about 0.018 dollars, only on explicit approval
budget.cap_rule: expected model calls per sample equals rounds plus one, worst equals maximum turns plus one retry, cap keeps at least 1.3 times the worst case

reporting_rules.evidence_level: development evidence on tasks that took part in building the configuration: it can demonstrate or refute a capability, it is never a confirmation, and its percentages are never merged with the v16 sealed batch
must_report: paired saving per task and pooled, with the engagement and fallback counters
the strict track and the semantic correctness per arm, side by side with the baseline
the fraction of each payload elided, and the note overhead in bytes, because the net saving is what counts
an explicit statement of what this experiment cannot show
forbidden_wording: the plugin saves about 12.5 percent of context

if_it_works: a positive result would establish, on development evidence, that compressing non redundant content under this evidence bar is possible; a citable number would then need fresh sealed tasks and a new registration, and the paused v18 candidate branch already has four derived and hashed views per candidate and needs only its literals re derived under the discriminative rule
if_it_fails: a negative result is equally publishable and closes the question: it would say that in this configuration the evidence bar and the compression are in direct tension, and that the lossless redundancy remover is the honest ceiling
